title: Projective-line trace before an exceptional adjoint
statement:
Let $N\geq1$ be an integer, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (a scheme admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings) on which $N$ is invertible. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ and let $q:P\to S$ be the projection [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Work on the small etale sites, in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-coefficient module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with module-sheaf direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], exact inverse image $q^*=q^{-1}$ [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. For a complex $L$ on $P$, $Rq_*L$ denotes the unbounded total right derived functor, computed as $Q(q_*I)$ for a K-injective resolution $L\to I$ [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist, lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived], where $Q$ is derived-category localization. For $T=S,P$, put
$$
A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}A_T,
\qquad
\mu_{N,T}(U)=\{z\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^\times:z^N=1\},
$$
with residue class $a$ acting on $z$ as $z^a$, as in [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. For a complex $M$ on $T$, write $M(1)=M\otimes_A^LA_T(1)$.

Let $h:A_S\to Rq_*A_P(1)[2]$ be the scalar-extended Kummer first Chern class of $\mathcal O_P(1)$: take the boundary of its line-bundle class for the exact Kummer sequence [lem-amb-kummer-any-base], extend coefficients from $\mathbf Z/N$ to $A$, and use the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction. Use the canonical projective-line decomposition
$$
b_q:A_S(1)[2]\oplus A_S\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_*A_P(1)[2]
$$
of [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-adjunction], whose components are the shifted, twisted unit and $h$. Define
$$
t_q=\operatorname{pr}_2\circ b_q^{-1}:Rq_*A_P(1)[2]\longrightarrow A_S.
$$
In particular $t_q\circ h=1_{A_S}$, since $h=b_q\circ\iota_2$ and $\operatorname{pr}_2\circ\iota_2=1_{A_S}$.

For every $K\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ define
$$
\epsilon_K:Rq_*\bigl(q^*K\otimes_A^LA_P(1)[2]\bigr)
\xrightarrow{\pi_{q,K,A_P(1)[2]}^{-1}}
K\otimes_A^LRq_*A_P(1)[2]
\xrightarrow{1_K\otimes t_q}K\otimes_A^LA_S
\xrightarrow{\sim}K,
$$
where $\pi$ is the canonical proper projection map of [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection], and the last arrow is the tensor unit isomorphism. Its hypotheses hold: $q$ is proper by [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper], hence of finite type by [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $P$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. The source is the notation $Rq_*q^*K(1)[2]$ of the blueprint.
